description: Macpac Films Limited is a Pakistani manufacturer of biaxially-oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films, which it describes as the pioneer of BOPP film production in the country. It makes plain, sealable and value-added films on Brückner lines at a factory in the Eastern Industrial Zone, Port Qasim, Karachi, and has supplied packaging films for more than two decades.
